content.title: Safety Shot expects to finalize Yerbae Brands acquisition next week
content.summary: Safety Shot (SHOT) provided an update on the expected timing for the closing of its previously announced acquisition of Yerbae Brands Corp. (YERBF). Following the approval of the acquisition by a majority of its stockholders on June 12, 2025, the companies have been working to complete the final administrative steps for the transaction. While the closing was anticipated this week, the process will now be finalized next week, in part to accommodate scheduling following the shortened holiday week.
